How do I apply for an internship?

Start with your education partner. The referral process uses a CV and a short note, followed by a conversation with the project lead. Confirm current availability and placement arrangements through that process.
Each intern works with a named project lead. Meetings follow a set weekly cadence, and each deliverable receives written feedback.
Which company signs the internship agreement?
Each internship is covered by a written agreement with Hopkins MedTech Group LLC.
What documents are available on completion?
Interns who complete the program receive a certificate of completion on company letterhead. A letter of recommendation is available on completion.
What are the rules for using AI tools?

Use only authorized data and project-lead-approved artificial intelligence (AI) tools. Do not upload confidential or patient-related information to public or unapproved tools. Verify AI-assisted work before delivery.
